<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Same answers, fewer launches. Liveness keeps its exact semantics (start-time identity breaks PID reuse); only the mechanism changes. Platform code is selected with cfg(target_os), never at runtime. Resolve-once lives in one place that every git/tmux launch site uses; it keeps hits only. The spawn counter keeps recording every launch that remains. |
| composition_root | — |
| contracts | — |

| rk-0002 | A new dependency adds supply-chain risk. | ADR, pinned version, age at least 7 days, allowlist row, audit gate. |
